title: Motion: tokenised durations and easings, reduced-motion respected
description: All enter, exit, and state-change animation uses durations and easing curves from the motion token set (defaults 150-250ms, ease-out). The application honours prefers-reduced-motion by disabling non-essential animation. No motion autoplays in critical flows such as auth, forms, and destructive confirmations.
rationale: Unmanaged motion is either absent (dead-feeling) or excessive (nauseating). A small token set with a reduced-motion escape hatch covers both failure modes.
